question: As of 10 April 2022, identify the state that has a bicameral legislature.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **At present only six Indian states have Bicameral legislature.**
 
• In states having a bicameral system, the state legislature consists of the **Governor, the legislative council and the legislative assembly.**
 
• The legislative council is the upper house, While the legislative assembly is the lowest house.
 
• **States having bicameral legislature**:
 
 
• Andhra Pradesh
 
• Telangana
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**
 
• Bihar 
 
• Maharastra 
 
• Karnataka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Legislature**

 
 
• The **State Legislature **consisted of the **Governor, the Legislative Assembly (Lower House) and sometimes the Legislative council (Upper House).**
 
• The strength of the **State Legislative assembly** varies from** 60 to 500** but states like **Sikkim, Goa, Mizoram, and Arunachal Pradesh** have less than** 60 members**.
 
• The** legislative council **is the permanent body and thus, is not subject to dissolution. 
 
• The normal tenure of every member is six years. **1/3rd **of its member retire after every second year.
